name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/enroll - put a subject on a cadence, once
description:
Enrols a subject. A SECOND ENROLMENT ON THE SAME CADENCE IS A DOUBLE SEND, so it is refused 409 rather than silently ignored - a caller that believes it enrolled and did not is how a prospect ends up on two parallel cadences. VERIFIED LIVE at 409. Enforced by a UNIQUE constraint on (tenant, subject, sequence) so two concurrent enrolments cannot both succeed.

THE OWNER IS CAPTURED AT ENROLMENT, because every step writes a NEXT and a NEXT needs an owner. An enrolment with no owner produces steps whose required action nobody holds. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A subject is enrolled and the enrolment id returned
Enrolling the same subject twice is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: This subject is already enrolled on that sequence
errorCases.when: an active enrolment already exists. Two enrolments on one cadence is a double send.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
